title: Saved my life
body:
Thank you so much for this incredibly app. It helped me so much, I’ve been using it for more than a year, and I almost haven’t skipped much days, which is shocking for me, someone who struggles with being consistent and stick to things specially long term… very surprising. And I just keep improving thanks to this app’s system, little by little I’ve been adding more goals and I have to say that I’m so grateful, my mental health really appreciates this app, I can’t say that all days are good, that I don’t fall back in the bad habits and cycles, but this app makes so much easier to get back on track, specially with all the actives and exercises it provides. Also, you can tell the team does care about the users and is very genuine, there is not ads and there is constant updates with more content every month. Thank you for everything, also for the gift plus, I really appreciate it. I can’t pay back at the moment but I hope you know how much your work is helping me and many other people. 

PD: I just wanted to mention some things I would add as a consistent user hehe… First, when I sort my goals by time, I’d like the ones to be at the bottom always, even after the goals that are at night, basically all the goals without specific time I’d like them to be grouped after the ones with timing, this way I can have “schedule” at the top in order and just general goals for the day at the bottom. Second, I wish Chile was an option for trips, as is the country I was born in, so, in case you want to add more countries I’d love if you consider Chile as an option :)
